integrity: The derivation is analytical. The included finite exact-rational checker is supporting diagnostics, not a proof of the infinite asymptotics. Historical novelty remains subject to independent literature verification.
scientific_limitations: The spectral and counting results hold for H-harmonic functions on the real four-ball with fixed weight s>-1 and a fixed interior radial cutoff 0<R<1, and are not asserted uniformly across moving weights, radii or dimensions. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Logarithmic spectral excess for hyperbolic-harmonic concentration in the four-ball
